questions.explanation:
## Why This Is Asked
This question evaluates the ability to design immutable audit and backup pipelines across multi-account and multi-region SAP deployments, ensuring regulatory retention, tamper-evidence, and auditable disaster recovery tests.

## Key Concepts
- S3 Object Lock in Governance mode for SAP HANA backups
- Cross-region replication for DR bucket redundancy
- CloudTrail multi-region trails combined with OpenTelemetry exporting to a central data lake
- Cross-account KMS CMK grants with key rotation implications
- Least-privilege IAM roles and Service Control Policies (SCPs)
- DR validation and audit integrity verification procedures

## Code Example
```yaml
Resources:
  SapBackupsBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub 'sap-backups-${AWS::AccountId}'
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      ObjectLockEnabled: true
      ObjectLockDefaultRetention:
        Mode: GOVERNANCE
        Days: 365
      BucketPolicy:
        PolicyText:
          Version: '2012-10-17'
          Statement:
            - Sid: DenyDeleteWithGovernance
              Effect: Deny
              Principal: '*'
              Action: 's3:DeleteObject'
              Resource:
                - !Sub '${SapBackupsBucket.Arn}/*'
              Condition:
                StringNotEquals:
                  s3:SignatureAge: '3600000'
```

questions.explanation:
## Why This Is Asked

This question evaluates the ability to design cross-account backup and residency controls in AWS SAP, with auditable trails and proper security controls.

## Key Concepts

- Cross-account IAM roles and Service Control Policies (SCPs)
- AWS S3 backups with data residency requirements
- KMS encryption and S3 bucket policies
- CloudTrail and AWS Config for auditing
- Infrastructure as Code (CloudFormation/CDK)

## Architecture Overview

The solution uses two AWS accounts (Prod and Compliance) with:
- Regional data residency enforcement via SCPs restricting resource creation
- Cross-account IAM role in the Compliance account for Prod to write backups
- S3 bucket policy enforcing bucket location and access controls
- CloudTrail logging all API calls for audit trails

## Code Example

```yaml
Resources:
  SAPBackupRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: arn:aws:iam::PROD_ACCOUNT_ID:root
      Path: /
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: SAPBackupPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Action:
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Effect: Allow
                Resource:
                  - arn:aws:s3:::eu-backups-bucket
                  - arn:aws:s3:::eu-backups-bucket/*

  BackupBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: eu-backups-bucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyOutsideEU
            Effect: Deny
            Action: s3:*
            NotPrincipal:
              AWS: arn:aws:iam::COMPLIANCE_ACCOUNT_ID:root
            Resource:
              - arn:aws:s3:::eu-backups-bucket
              - arn:aws:s3:::eu-backups-bucket/*
            Condition:
              StringNotEquals:
                s3:Region: eu-west-1
```

## Why This Is Asked
This question evaluates practical knowledge of implementing secure credential rotation for SAP HANA deployments in AWS, ensuring adherence to security best practices and automation principles.

## Key Concepts
- AWS Secrets Manager rotation lifecycle for SAP credentials
- SAP HANA SQL commands for user password management
- IAM role design with cross-service permissions and least privilege
- Infrastructure as Code using CloudFormation for reproducible deployments

## Code Example
```yaml
Resources:
  SAPSecret:
    Type: AWS::SecretsManager::Secret
    Properties:
      Name: sap/prod/hana
      Description: "SAP HANA production credentials"
      GenerateSecretString:
        SecretStringTemplate: '{"username":"sapadm"}'
        GenerateStringKey: "password"
        PasswordLength: 32
        ExcludeCharacters: '"@/\'
      RotationRule:
        AutomaticallyAfterDays: 30
        RotationLambdaARN: !GetAtt SAPRotationFunction.Arn
  SAPRotationFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: SAPHANA-Rotation
      Runtime: python3.9
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Role: !GetAtt SAPRotationRole.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          HANA_HOST: !Ref HANAHost
          HANA_PORT: !Ref HANAPort
```

```yaml
Resources:
  BackupBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Properties:
      BucketName: sap-cross-region-backup-${AWS::Region}
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      ReplicationConfiguration:
        Role: !GetAtt ReplicationRole.Arn
        Rules:
          - Destination:
              Bucket: arn:aws:s3:::sap-backup-dr-us-west-2
              StorageClass: STANDARD
            Status: Enabled

  ReplicationRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
      Version: 2012-10-17
      Statement:
        - Effect: Allow
          Principal:
            Service: s3.amazonaws.com
          Action: sts:AssumeRole

  PipelineRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Policies:
      - PolicyName: sap-pipeline-policy
        PolicyDocument:
          Version: 2012-10-17
          Statement:
            - Effect: Allow
              Action:
                - s3:GetObject
                - s3:PutObject
              Resource: !Sub ${BackupBucket.Arn}/*
```
